label: Iwi Futures paper describes a draft Māori land-resource evaluation module
summary: Garth Harmsworth and Alec Mackay documented a draft step-by-step land and resource evaluation module developed from four Māori land case studies, with GIS repositories and access-restricted cultural layers.

sources.label: Harmsworth and Mackay, Māori Land Resource Assessment and Evaluation Tool, Iwi Futures programme, 2010
